cases.description: Required keys only: defaults for every optional key.
Absolute opencode_env_file is kept verbatim.
Relative opencode_env_file resolves against the config directory.
Only the first slash separates provider and model; later slashes stay in the model id.
Relative workspace resolves against the projects.toml directory and is canonicalized.
A symlink workspace is resolved with resolve(strict=True) to its canonical target.

error_categories.allow_parallel_writers_direct: allow_parallel_writers=true is accepted only together with execution_mode='worktree'.
error_categories.auto_approve_permissions_entry: auto_approve_permissions entries must be non-empty strings without surrounding whitespace.
error_categories.auto_approve_permissions_external_direct: 'external_directory' is rejected in auto_approve_permissions; use auto_approve_external_directories.
error_categories.auto_approve_permissions_type: auto_approve_permissions must be a list of strings.
error_categories.default_profile_type: default_profile must be a non-empty string.
error_categories.default_profile_unknown: default_profile does not name a builtin or custom profile.
error_categories.default_profile_whitespace: default_profile must not have surrounding whitespace.
error_categories.duplicate_endpoint: A server endpoint is reused by more than one project or by the MCP server of the same project.
error_categories.duplicate_mcp_token_file: An MCP token file is reused across projects.
error_categories.duplicate_workspace: The same canonical workspace is bound to more than one project.
error_categories.env_duplicate_name: The env file defines the same variable name twice.
error_categories.env_file_mode: The env file mode is not exactly 0600.
error_categories.env_file_not_regular: The env file path is not a regular file.
error_categories.env_file_owner: The env file is not owned by the current user.
error_categories.env_file_symlink: The env file is a symlink (O_NOFOLLOW fail-closed).
error_categories.env_invalid_name: An env line has an invalid variable name.
error_categories.env_invalid_utf8: The env file is not valid UTF-8.
error_categories.env_line_missing_equals: An env line has no '=' separator.
error_categories.env_nul_byte: An env line contains a NUL byte.
error_categories.env_protected_name: The env file defines a reserved agent-bridge service variable.
error_categories.execution_mode_whitespace: execution_mode must not have surrounding whitespace.
error_categories.external_directory_missing: A trusted external directory does not exist.
error_categories.external_directory_not_absolute: A trusted external directory is not an absolute path.
error_categories.external_directory_not_directory: A trusted external path is not a directory.
error_categories.external_directory_root: The filesystem root '/' is rejected as a trusted external directory.
error_categories.external_directory_type: auto_approve_external_directories must be a list of strings.
error_categories.invalid_project_id: The project id does not match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$.
error_categories.max_active_tasks_invalid: max_active_tasks must be a positive integer (bool is not accepted).
error_categories.max_rounds_not_positive: max_rounds must be a positive integer (bool is not accepted).
error_categories.mcp_pairing: mcp_url and mcp_token_file must be set together or both omitted.
error_categories.mcp_token_equals_password: The MCP token file must be separate from the project password file.
error_categories.mcp_token_file_type: mcp_token_file must be a non-empty string.
error_categories.mcp_url_endpoint: The MCP URL endpoint must be http on 127.0.0.1 with an explicit valid port.
error_categories.missing_required_key: A required project key is absent.
error_categories.opencode_env_file_type: opencode_env_file must be a non-empty string.
error_categories.opencode_model_format: opencode_model must be '<providerID>/<modelID>' split on the first slash.
error_categories.opencode_model_whitespace: opencode_model and its components must not have surrounding whitespace.
error_categories.opencode_url_credentials: opencode_url must not embed username or password.
error_categories.opencode_url_missing_port: opencode_url must include an explicit port.
error_categories.opencode_url_path: opencode_url must not contain a path.
error_categories.opencode_url_query_or_fragment: opencode_url must not contain a query or fragment.
error_categories.opencode_url_scheme: opencode_url must use the http scheme.
error_categories.profile_id_invalid: A custom profile id must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$.
error_categories.profile_instructions_control: Custom profile instructions must not contain control characters.
error_categories.profile_instructions_secret: Custom profile instructions carry a suspected credential.
error_categories.profile_instructions_too_long: Custom profile instructions exceed the 8000-character limit.
error_categories.profile_instructions_type: Custom profile instructions must be a string.
error_categories.profile_missing_purpose: A custom profile is missing its required 'purpose' key.
error_categories.profile_model_format: A custom profile model must be '<providerID>/<modelID>'.
error_categories.profile_model_type: A custom profile model must be a string.
error_categories.profile_model_whitespace: A custom profile model must not have surrounding whitespace.
error_categories.profile_not_table: A custom profile entry must be a table.
error_categories.profile_purpose_control: Custom profile purpose must not contain control characters.
error_categories.profile_purpose_invalid: Custom profile purpose must be a non-empty string.
error_categories.profile_purpose_too_long: Custom profile purpose exceeds the 200-character limit.
error_categories.profile_snapshot_corrupt: The pinned profile snapshot is malformed or fails its identity/hash check.
error_categories.profile_unknown_key: A custom profile table contains an unknown key.

error_categories.unknown_profile: A submit-time requested profile id is not known.

placeholder_conventions.${CONFIG_DIR}: Absolute path of the fixture directory that contains projects.toml.
placeholder_conventions.${ENV_FILE}: Absolute path of an existing env file used to test absolute-path semantics.
placeholder_conventions.${FILE_PATH}: Absolute path of an existing regular file (not a directory).
placeholder_conventions.${MISSING_DIR}: Absolute path that does not exist.
placeholder_conventions.${OTHER_WORKSPACE}: Absolute path of a second existing directory, distinct from ${WORKSPACE}.
placeholder_conventions.${PARENT_DIR}: Absolute path of an existing directory that contains ${OTHER_WORKSPACE}.
placeholder_conventions.${TRUSTED_DIR}: Absolute path of an existing directory used as a trusted external root.
placeholder_conventions.${WORKSPACE}: Absolute path of an existing directory (the primary workspace).
